text.p: -- Bear Stearns analyst David Molowa said he downgraded Astra Ab to attractive from buy.
-- Lowered his 1997 earnings per share estimate on the Swedish drug maker to 17.1 crowns per share from 18.8 and his 1998 estimate to 19.8 crowns from 21.5.
-- Company reported first quarter earnings of 4.04 crowns per share. Bear Stearns had forecast earnings of 4.43 a share.
-- Molowa said Astra is hurt by high exposure to European pharmaceutical market, which is growing at a slower rate than the U.S. market.
-- Said kept attractive rating because stock represents a good value, trading at 15.5 times his 1998 earnings estimate, compared to the average drug company trading at a multiple of about 18.5.
-- "I think there's good value there for a long-term value-oriented investor but it doesn't warrant a buy rating," he said.
